User has selected the official Espressif ESP32-S31 Korvo factory_demo as the final performance/platform demo, implemented USING OPENVELA, not by flashing ESP-IDF. Preserve the separate digit-recognition demo. Prior field-registration demo is superseded. Shared workspace /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. Official pinned source is being downloaded (main/UI already present) into backups/factory-demo-port/upstream/examples/esp32-s31-korvo/examples/factory_demo, commit recorded in upstream-commit.json. Current E402 SMP native services + WiFi + BLE + MEDIA build is still running: DO NOT change maintained sources or build inputs, do not start full builds, do not access serial/USB/boards. Write only inside YOUR private directory under backups/factory-demo-port. Use actual openvela APIs, preserve upstream notices/licenses, no mocked hardware success or invented performance. Do not spawn other workers. Source modifications stay private; root integrates after review. Need concrete code/candidate and concise result, not just advice. Keep required original factory capabilities in scope. Read local relevant instructions. English source/comments/public docs. Existing root s31-reference AGENTS restriction against UI is overridden by explicit user scope. Current LVGL is 9.x, upstream UI is 9.2.2. Existing native application example: openvela-dev/frameworks/runtimes/services/xmsdemo/platform and lvgldemo; framework uikit/window LVGL APIs. Build compile_commands reference is backups/product-integration-execution/build-v1/build/compile_commands.json. No full firmware build; small targeted compile checks are allowed after candidate prepared.

YOUR DIRECTORY: /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/factory-demo-port-e403/ui-port

Own the native application and coffee UI port. Analyze how to retain ALL upstream generated coffee screens, animations, fonts and events while using openvela native Activity/Window graphics ownership. Create private candidate openvela-dev/frameworks/runtimes/services/xmsdemo/factory with FactoryActivity / Application, manifest, Kconfig and CMakeLists. Reuse original coffee UI with necessary lifecycle bridge; preserve original visual design. Also adapt factory dashboard UI (camera preview, audio record/play, buttons/LED, USB HID, SD status) from main/main.c using abstract native backend contract; define FactoryBackend.h for a POSIX-backed implementation by another worker/root. DO NOT implement assets decoder or hardware backend; specify contract clearly in contracts.md immediately. Camera backend should provide RGB565 buffer frames and real timestamps/counters; maintain LVGL thread ownership and safe destroy. Use existing Activity getWindow root; investigate lv_screen_load vs window root carefully rather than pretending compatibility. Design a concrete safe lifetime bridge. Provide config/resource requirements and targeted compilation receipts. Asset API should retain coffee_assets_init()/get_src(), ports will supply native implementation. Contact root via result file if ownership contract needed. Minimal visible performance overlay with genuine measured draw/frame intervals, no hardcoded FPS. Result result.md and candidate manifest/diff. Do not change existing PlatformActivity or main profile.

I’ll inspect the native Activity/Window APIs and upstream UI, then write the backend contract and candidate in the assigned directory. I’ll preserve the generated coffee UI and check how its screen transitions can safely stay within the Activity window.

The initial contract is written. The existing WidgetsActivity confirms that the native window shares a display, so the coffee UI cannot use its upstream global screen-loading calls. I’m adapting navigation to window-owned panels and checking animation cleanup before implementing the bridge.

The pinned source clarifies two capabilities: USB HID displays input from a connected keyboard or mouse, and audio records into a six-second buffer before playback. I’ve corrected the contract accordingly. The port will retain all 12 coffee screens and 10 fonts, with animation cancellation scoped to coffee objects during teardown.

The candidate now contains the generated coffee UI and the adapted dashboard layout. The bridge preserves the upstream navigation delays and screen events without replacing the window manager’s active screen. Camera frames use a nonblocking lease-and-copy contract, so LVGL retains its own preview buffer.

The native Activity compiled successfully against the E402 RISC-V configuration; checks for the remaining UI units are running privately. The overlay reports measured display draw duration, redraw intervals, and camera timestamp intervals. It will show `--` when samples are missing or stale.

The first compile pass covered all 45 UI units. It found one missing dependency: a generated component uses LVGL’s Montserrat 46 font, which E402 omits. I’ve added that requirement and am recompiling the affected units. Leaving coffee or pausing the Activity currently resets coffee to its splash screen on return; that lifecycle behavior is documented.

All 45 current UI units now compile, and a relocatable link found no unresolved internal UI symbols. The retention audit also passed: all 12 screens, 32 animation functions, 10 fonts and 45 generated image sources are present. I’m packaging the diff and receipts; provider linking and board validation remain for root integration.

Candidate ready for root review: [result.md](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/factory-demo-port-e403/ui-port/result.md).

- Retains all 12 coffee screens, 32 animations, fonts and dashboard capabilities.
- Adds native Activity/Window ownership and safe lifecycle cleanup.
- **45/45 targeted compilations passed**; relocatable link passed.
- [Backend contract](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/factory-demo-port-e403/ui-port/contracts.md) and [candidate diff](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/factory-demo-port-e403/ui-port/candidate.diff) included.

Providers and board validation remain for integration. Coffee restarts at splash after pause/reentry. All changes stayed private; no maintained build inputs or boards were touched.
